function.name: impl_from_IRecordInfo
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface pointer for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: IRecordInfoImpl pointer, which represents the containing record for the given interface pointer.

function.name: copy_to_variant
function.description: This function copies the value from the source to the VARIANT structure based on the specified VARENUM enumeration type.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source from which the value is copied.

parameters.name: pvar
parameters.description: This is the VARIANT structure to which the value is copied.

parameters.name: vt
parameters.description: This is the VARENUM enumeration type that specifies the type of the value to be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns E_NOTIMPL if the type is not supported.

function.name: copy_from_variant
function.description: This function copies data from a VARIANT type to a specified destination type. It uses the VariantChangeType function to convert the VARIANT type to the desired type, and then copies the data to the destination.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source VARIANT from which data is to be copied.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: This is the destination where the data from the source VARIANT is to be copied.

parameters.name: vt
parameters.description: This is the desired type to which the source VARIANT is to be converted before copying.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, E_NOTIMPL if the type is not supported, and the error code if the VariantChangeType function fails.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IRecordInfo. If it matches, the function adds a reference to the interface and returns S_OK. If it doesn't match, the function returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be checked

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Interface ID to be compared with the interface's ID

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer to the interface, used to return the interface if the IDs match

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IRecordInfo, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of an IRecordInfo interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IRecordInfo interface whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the interface and frees the memory allocated for the fields and the name if the reference count is zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that needs to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count after the release operation

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_RecordInit
function.description: This function initializes a record by setting its memory to zero. If the provided pointer is null, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IRecordInfo interface

parameters.name: pvNew
parameters.description: Pointer to the record to be initialized

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the provided pointer is null

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_RecordClear
function.description: This function clears the record information. It checks if the provided record exists, then iterates through the fields of the record and clears or releases the memory based on the type of the field.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface which provides methods for managing record information.

parameters.name: pvExisting
parameters.description: Pointer to the existing record that needs to be cleared.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_INVALIDARG if the provided record does not exist.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_RecordCopy
function.description: This function copies the content of a source record to a destination record. It also handles special cases for different types of fields in the record, such as strings, unknown types, dispatch types, and safe arrays.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that provides methods for managing records.

parameters.name: src_rec
parameters.description: Pointer to the source record to be copied.

parameters.name: dest_rec
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination record where the source record will be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the source or destination record is NULL, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to allocate for a string, or the result of SafeArrayCopy if a safe array is being copied.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetGuid
function.description: This function retrieves the GUID from the IRecordInfo interface implementation and assigns it to the provided GUID pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface.

parameters.name: pguid
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID variable where the GUID of the IRecordInfo interface will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetName
function.description: This function retrieves the name of the IRecordInfo interface implementation and assigns it to the BSTR pointer passed as a parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface whose name is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: pbstrName
parameters.description: Pointer to a BSTR where the name of the IRecordInfo interface will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents successful execution and E_INVALIDARG represents an invalid argument error.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of the record.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IRecordInfo interface

parameters.name: pcbSize
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG variable where the size of the record will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, otherwise returns an error code

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetTypeInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the type information for an interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IRecordInfo interface.

parameters.name: ppTypeInfo
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the ITypeInfo interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the function fails.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetField
function.description: This function retrieves a field from a record using the field name. It checks the validity of the input parameters, searches for the field in the record, and if found, clears the variant and copies the field value to the variant.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface

parameters.name: pvData
parameters.description: Pointer to the data of the record

parameters.name: szFieldName
parameters.description: Name of the field to be retrieved

parameters.name: pvarField
parameters.description: Pointer to a VARIANT where the field value will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if any of the input parameters is NULL, TYPE_E_FIELDNOTFOUND if the field is not found in the record, or the result of the copy_to_variant function.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetFieldNoCopy
function.description: This function retrieves the value of a field from a record without making a copy of the field. It also checks for invalid arguments and whether the field is found.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface

parameters.name: pvData
parameters.description: Pointer to the data of the record

parameters.name: szFieldName
parameters.description: Name of the field to retrieve

parameters.name: pvarField
parameters.description: Pointer to the VARIANT that receives the field value

parameters.name: ppvDataCArray
parameters.description: Pointer to the array that receives the field data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if any argument is invalid, and TYPE_E_FIELDNOTFOUND if the field is not found.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_PutField
function.description: This function is used to put a field in the IRecordInfo interface implementation. It checks the validity of the parameters, handles the case when the wFlags parameter is INVOKE_PROPERTYPUTREF, and copies the variant from the pvarField to the field in the IRecordInfo interface implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface

parameters.name: wFlags
parameters.description: Flag to indicate the type of operation

parameters.name: pvData
parameters.description: Pointer to the data

parameters.name: szFieldName
parameters.description: Name of the field

parameters.name: pvarField
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to be copied to the field

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can be E_INVALIDARG if the arguments are not valid, E_NOTIMPL if the wFlags is INVOKE_PROPERTYPUTREF, TYPE_E_FIELDNOTFOUND if the field is not found, or the result of the copy_from_variant function.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_PutFieldNoCopy
function.description: This function is used to put a field into a record without copying it. It checks the validity of the parameters and if the field exists in the record.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the record info

parameters.name: wFlags
parameters.description: Flags to specify the type of property put

parameters.name: pvData
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be put in the field

parameters.name: szFieldName
parameters.description: Name of the field where the data is to be put

parameters.name: pvarField
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to be put in the field

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the parameters are invalid, TYPE_E_FIELDNOTFOUND if the field does not exist in the record, and E_NOTIMPL if the function is not implemented yet.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_GetFieldNames
function.description: This function retrieves the names of the fields from a record. It checks the validity of the parameters, adjusts the count of names to be retrieved based on the input, and if the names array is provided, it populates it with the names of the fields.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRecordInfo interface.

parameters.name: pcNames
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG variable that on input contains the number of names to be retrieved and on output contains the actual number of names retrieved.

parameters.name: rgBstrNames
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of BSTRs that receives the names of the fields. This parameter can be NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, and E_INVALIDARG if the pcNames parameter is NULL.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_IsMatchingType
function.description: This function checks if the GUID of the two IRecordInfo instances match.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: First IRecordInfo instance.

parameters.name: info2
parameters.description: Second IRecordInfo instance to compare with the first one.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the GUIDs of the two IRecordInfo instances match, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_RecordCreate
function.description: This function creates a record and initializes it using the IRecordInfo interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IRecordInfo interface used for record creation and initialization.

function.return_type: PVOID, which represents the created record.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_RecordCreateCopy
function.description: This function creates a copy of a record using the provided source and destination pointers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used for the record information implementation.

parameters.name: pvSource
parameters.description: Pointer to the source from where the record is to be copied.

parameters.name: ppvDest
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination where the copied record will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_INVALIDARG if either source or destination pointer is NULL, otherwise returns the status of the record copy operation.

function.name: IRecordInfoImpl_RecordDestroy
function.description: This function clears the record and frees the memory allocated to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IRecordInfo interface

parameters.name: pvRecord
parameters.description: Pointer to the record to be destroyed

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if successful, error code if failed

function.name: GetRecordInfoFromGuids
function.description: This function retrieves the record information from the given GUIDs.

parameters.name: rGuidTypeLib
parameters.description: The GUID of the type library

parameters.name: uVerMajor
parameters.description: The major version of the type library

parameters.name: uVerMinor
parameters.description: The minor version of the type library

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: The locale identifier

parameters.name: rGuidTypeInfo
parameters.description: The GUID of the type information

parameters.name: ppRecInfo
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to the IRecordInfo interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function

function.name: GetRecordInfoFromTypeInfo
function.description: This function retrieves record information from a type information interface.

parameters.name: pTI
parameters.description: Pointer to the type information interface.

parameters.name: ppRecInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the record information interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns an error code.
